title: Machine code bound
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ and natural numbers $n,S$, define its code bound to be $2^{\, igl(	ext{code-size parameter of }N igr) igl(S+	ext{log-space bound at }n+1 igr)}$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include definitions of the machine's code-size parameter or the log-space bound.
